title: A hátország terhei és a mindennapok (The Home Front)
grammar: Past Conditional Volna in Historical Context, War Obligation & Epochal Connectors

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe daily life on the home front: rationing, shortages and women at work.
I can say what would have happened otherwise, using the past conditional with volna.
I can use the words for rationing, the war economy and war loans.
I can read a short account of the home front and answer questions about it.
